archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for Premium Architecture

typography.font_pairings_rationale: Cabinet Grotesk provides a modern, structural, and premium authoritative feel avoiding the overused 'tech' look of Inter/Space Grotesk. Manrope offers exceptional legibility for dense dashboard data.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold leading-snug

colors.rationale: Deep navy (#1C2541/#0B132B) establishes trust and premium contractor authority. Emerald (#06D6A0) reflects sports turf and energy. Orange (#FF9F1C) is used sparingly for high-converting CTAs.

hero_section.layout: Fullscreen cinematic background image with overlay (`bg-black/40` to `bg-black/60`). Text block centered or heavily left-aligned with overlaps. Beneath the main CTA, a row of animated statistics counters (e.g., '100+ Projects', '15 Years Exp') floating on a glassmorphism card over the hero bottom edge.
hero_section.components: H1, Subtitle, Primary CTA (Orange), Secondary CTA (Outline White), Framer Motion Counters.

service_cards.design: Bento Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Cards should have relative positioning, using either high-quality Unsplash backgrounds with dark gradient overlays or flat background with a top icon. Include hover state: `-translate-y-2`, shadow-xl, and an animated arrow emerging.

portfolio_gallery.layout: Grid-based masonry or uniform grid with a category filter row above (All, Mini Soccer, Basketball, etc.).
portfolio_gallery.features: Implement a 'Before-After' image slider component inside the cards or upon clicking a modal. The slider needs an interactive drag handle.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (left, or right for RTL) + Main content area. Topbar with global search and user profile.
admin_dashboard.glassmorphism: Use Crystal Glass effect for the sidebar and topbar: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70` (light mode) or `bg-black/60` (dark mode), with a crisp 1px inner border (`border-white/20` or `border-white/10`).
admin_dashboard.widgets: Dashboard cards should be tactile (Neumorphism touch or crisp flat UI with 1px border). Charts (Shadcn/Recharts) should utilize the Emerald and Orange palette.

floating_elements.whatsapp: Fixed bottom right, z-50, vibrant Emerald background, pulsing animation (`animate-pulse` on a ring layer behind it).

layout_and_components.spacing: Generous. Use `py-24` or `py-32` for section spacing. Card paddings should be `p-6` or `p-8`.

guidelines: Scroll reveals: Use `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` and `whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}` for staggered lists.
Hero: Smooth fade up on load.
Micro-interactions: Buttons should scale down slightly on tap (`whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}`).
Counters: Use `framer-motion` useSpring combined with useInView for smooth number incrementing.

hero_cinematic.description: Empty football field aerial - Perfect for main cinematic hero background
Aerial view soccer field daytime - Good alternate hero

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and navigation links MUST include data-testid. Examples: `data-testid='hero-cta'`, `data-testid='service-card-1'`, `data-testid='lang-switcher'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI using pure HTML+Tailwind for organic marketing layouts to achieve the premium architecture vibe.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for functional/interactive elements (Forms, Modals, Admin Dashboard widgets, Dropdowns).
Implement internationalization (i18n) for ID, EN, and AR. Ensure full RTL layout toggle when Arabic is selected (dir='rtl').
Add Dark/Light mode toggle utilizing standard Tailwind 'dark:' utility classes.
Do not use generic sans fonts like Inter or Space Grotesk. Map Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Manrope for body text.
